name: Ragefire Chasm
hordeAccess: Inside Orgrimmar, in the Cleft of Shadow. The easiest dungeon for Horde to reach.

quests.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
quests.howTo: Pick up from Rahauro in Thunder Bluff. Kill Ragefire Troggs inside Ragefire Chasm.

quests.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
quests.howTo: Pick up from Rahauro in Thunder Bluff. Find Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside Ragefire Chasm and recover his satchel.

quests.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
quests.howTo: Take it from Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside the dungeon and bring the satchel back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Slaying the Beast
quests.howTo: Pick up from Neeru Fireblade next to the dungeon portal. Kill Taragaman the Hungerer and bring back his heart.

quests.name: The Power to Destroy...
quests.howTo: Pick up from Varimathras in Undercity. Loot the two spell books from Searing Blade casters in Ragefire Chasm.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.howTo: Third step of Thrall's Hidden Enemies chain. Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker in Ragefire Chasm, then report back to Thrall.

name: Hall of Thanes
hordeAccess: Alliance-city dungeon: entrance is in Old Ironforge below the High Seat (left corridor from the throne room, ~43.5, 52.0). Horde must cross Dun Morogh and fight or sneak through guarded Ironforge (stealth/soulstone/group); Horde has no quests there and no shortcut is known.

quests.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
quests.prereq: Nip 'Em in the Bud (from a Dark Iron Map dropped by Dark Iron Spies, Dun Morogh ~76.7, 60.7)
quests.howTo: Loot the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer from the final boss and bring it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Treaty of Understanding
quests.location: Reliquary of Kings, final boss room
quests.howTo: Pick up the treaty after the last boss and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge. Not shareable.

quests.name: Important Heirlooms
quests.location: Old Ironforge, by the bridge just outside the dungeon entrance
quests.howTo: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms inside the dungeon and return to Thom Filch.

quests.name: The Restless Dead
quests.location: Up the stairs from the dungeon entrance (Old Ironforge)
quests.howTo: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions and 10 Tormented Souls in the dungeon.

quests.name: An Ancient Grudge
quests.location: Second room inside Hall of Thanes
quests.howTo: Kill Faldrim Anvilmar, the first boss, and turn in to the Ghostly Attendant on the way out.

name: Deadmines
hordeAccess: Moonbrook in Westfall, Alliance land with no Horde flight point. Fly to Grom'gol, then ride north through Duskwood into Westfall. Expect Alliance guards and players.

quests.name: Red Silk Bandanas
quests.howTo: Pick up from Scout Riell at Sentinel Hill. Collect Red Silk Bandanas from Defias inside the Deadmines.

quests.name: Collecting Memories
quests.howTo: Pick up in Stormwind. Collect Miners' Union Cards from the undead miners in the outer Moonbrook mine, before the instance portal.

quests.name: Oh Brother...
quests.howTo: Pick up in Stormwind. Kill Foreman Thistlenettle in the outer mine and bring back his badge.

quests.name: Underground Assault
quests.prereq: Speak with Shoni (optional, from Gnoarn in Ironforge)
quests.howTo: Pick up from Shoni the Silent. Loot the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from Sneed's Shredder inside the Deadmines.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.howTo: Final step of Gryan Stoutmantle's long Westfall chain. Kill Edwin VanCleef at the end of the Deadmines and bring back his head.

quests.name: The Unsent Letter
quests.giver: An Unsent Letter (drops from Edwin VanCleef)
quests.howTo: Loot the letter from Edwin VanCleef and bring it to Baros Alexston in Stormwind City. Starts the chain that leads into the Stockade.

name: Ruins of Lordaeron
hordeAccess: Easy for Horde: entrance is in the ruined Lordaeron city above Undercity (72.4, 11.6); go through the keep's front gate and take the stairs on the left.

quests.name: Light's Justice
quests.howTo: Collect 25 Intact Limbs from undead enemies inside the dungeon.

quests.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
quests.location: Between Brill and Undercity, Tirisfal Glades (65.2, 60.1)
quests.prereq: Two Rear Guard Patrol quests from the NPC beside Kristof
quests.howTo: Kill Rath'mael in the dungeon.

quests.name: A Frightened Request
quests.howTo: Find the body of Edward Heartweaver inside the dungeon.

quests.name: Remember That I Love You
quests.giver: Crumpled Paper by Edward Heartweaver's body
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; turn in to Orphan Matron Nightingale, Stormwind
quests.howTo: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind.

quests.name: The New Plague
quests.prereq: A Recipe for Death chain (Silverpine Forest)
quests.howTo: Loot a Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in the dungeon.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; turned in to Master Apothecary Faranell, Apothecarium, Undercity
quests.howTo: Loot the Abominable Head from The Baron and follow Faranell's multi-step chain in Undercity.

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.giver: Crest of Lordaeron (item in one of five random spots)
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; turn in to Oran Snakewrithe, Magic Quarter, Undercity (73.3, 32.6)
quests.howTo: Find the Crest in the dungeon and deliver it to Oran Snakewrithe.

quests.name: Abominable Creatures
quests.location: Inside the dungeon near the entrance
quests.howTo: Loot the Head of The Baron.

quests.name: Bloodied Insignia
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; turn in to General Marcus Jonathan, Stormwind
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias from undead mobs.

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.giver: Crest of Lordaeron (item in one of five random spots)
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; turn in to Lady Dena Kennedy, Stormwind Keep
quests.howTo: Find the Crest in the dungeon and deliver it to Lady Dena Kennedy.

name: Wailing Caverns
hordeAccess: A cave in the oasis southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Fly to the Crossroads.

quests.name: Leaders of the Fang
quests.prereq: Nara Wildmane (end of Tonga Runetotem's oasis chain)
quests.howTo: Pick up from Nara Wildmane. Kill the four Fanglords (Anacondra, Cobrahn, Pythas, Serpentis) and bring back their gems.

quests.name: Smart Drinks
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ratchet. Collect Wailing Essence from ectoplasm mobs in and around Wailing Caverns.

quests.name: Deviate Hides
quests.location: The Barrens / cave above the Wailing Caverns entrance
quests.howTo: Pick up from Nalpak in the hidden cave above the entrance. Collect Deviate Hides from deviate beasts.

quests.name: Serpentbloom
quests.howTo: Pick up in Thunder Bluff. Gather Serpentbloom flowers growing in the caverns.

quests.name: Trouble at the Docks
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ratchet. Kill Mad Magglish inside Wailing Caverns and recover the stolen bottle of 99-Year-Old Port.

quests.name: Deviate Eradication
quests.location: The Barrens / cave above the Wailing Caverns entrance
quests.howTo: Pick up from Ebru next to Nalpak. Kill deviate ravagers, vipers, shamblers and dreadfangs inside.

quests.name: The Glowing Shard
quests.giver: The Glowing Shard (drops from Mutanus the Devourer)
quests.howTo: Loot the shard from Mutanus after waking Naralex. Take it to Sputtervalve in Ratchet, who sends you on to Falla Sagewind.

name: Shadowfang Keep
hordeAccess: Silverpine Forest, south of the Sepulcher. Fly to the Sepulcher and ride south.

quests.name: The Book of Ur
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Find the Book of Ur in the library area of Shadowfang Keep.

quests.name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
quests.howTo: Pick up at the Sepulcher. Find the captured Deathstalkers inside the keep (Adamant is in the first cell; Vincent is in the courtyard).

quests.name: Arugal Must Die
quests.howTo: Pick up at the Sepulcher. Kill Archmage Arugal at the top of the keep and bring back his head.

quests.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
quests.location: The Barrens / east of Camp Taurajo
quests.howTo: Warlock only. Needs a Large Soran'ruk Fragment from Shadowfang Darksouls here plus Soran'ruk Fragments from Blackfathom Deeps.

name: Blackfathom Deeps
hordeAccess: Zoram Strand on the Ashenvale coast. Fly to Zoram'gar Outpost, which is right next to it.

quests.name: Knowledge in the Deeps
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ironforge. Find the Lorgalis Manuscript underwater inside Blackfathom Deeps.

quests.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
quests.prereq: Trouble in the Deeps (optional, from Tsunaman in Stonetalon)
quests.howTo: Pick up at Zoram'gar. Collect Sapphires of Aku'Mai from the tunnels leading into the dungeon.

quests.name: Researching the Corruption
quests.prereq: The Corruption Abroad (optional, from Argos Nightwhisper)
quests.howTo: Pick up in Auberdine. Collect Corrupt Brain Stems from naga and satyr inside.

quests.name: In Search of Thaelrid
quests.howTo: Pick up in Darnassus. Find Argent Guard Thaelrid inside Blackfathom Deeps.

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
quests.howTo: Pick up from Thaelrid inside the dungeon. Kill Twilight Lord Kelris and take his head to Bashana Runetotem (Thunder Bluff) or Dawnwatcher Selgorm (Darnassus).

quests.name: Twilight Falls
quests.howTo: Pick up in Darnassus. Collect Twilight Pendants from Twilight's Hammer cultists inside.

quests.name: Amongst the Ruins
quests.howTo: Pick up at Zoram'gar. Get the Fathom Core from the pool near Lorgus Jett.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
quests.prereq: Allegiance to the Old Gods (starts from a Damp Note dropped in the dungeon)
quests.howTo: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu, then kill Lorgus Jett inside Blackfathom Deeps.

quests.name: Baron Aquanis
quests.giver: Strange Water Globe (drops from Baron Aquanis)
quests.howTo: Loot the Strange Water Globe from Baron Aquanis and take it to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar.

quests.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
quests.location: The Barrens / east of Camp Taurajo
quests.howTo: Warlock only. Collect Soran'ruk Fragments from Twilight acolytes here plus a Large Soran'ruk Fragment from Shadowfang Keep.

name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
hordeAccess: Fly to Hammerfall (Arathi), ride south through the Thandol Span fork into the Wetlands, and follow the road to the path left of Thelgen Rock (~53.9, 65.4); dungeon entrance at 48.1, 56.5. Pick up Dragonmaw Rumors at Hammerfall on the way.

quests.name: Changing Tastes
quests.location: Second floor of The Drag, Orgrimmar (57.3, 53.3)
quests.howTo: Collect 4 Thicket Raptor Meat from raptors inside the dungeon and return to Borstan.

quests.name: Open the Maw
quests.howTo: Kill 2 Dragonmaw Saboteurs and 4 Dragonmaw Warders and loot a Dragonmaw Dispatch inside; turn in to the agent on the way out.

quests.name: Elder Knowledge
quests.giver: Titan Relic (drop from Relic Guardian, final boss)
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; deliver to Bashana Runetotem, Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff (70.8, 33.7)
quests.howTo: Use the Titan Relic from the last boss and take it to Bashana Runetotem; leads to Earthen Echo (Muln Earthfury).

quests.name: Songblade Search
quests.howTo: Find Daewyn's body in the Dragonmaw area after the second boss and return to Dorin.

quests.name: Lost in the Thicket Things
quests.howTo: Find her husband Ardin near the final boss arena and bring back Heartwoven.

quests.name: Highland Hides
quests.howTo: Collect 4 Thicket Raptor Hides inside the dungeon.

quests.name: Horrors in the Highland
quests.prereq: Tramping Paws, Fire Taboo, Blisters on the Land
quests.howTo: Defeat the optional Highland Horror and bring back a Horrible Rootcore.

quests.name: Lost Relic Carry
quests.giver: Titan Relic (drop from Relic Guardian, final boss)
quests.location: Inside the dungeon; deliver to Prospector Whelgar near Menethil Harbor
quests.howTo: Take the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar; leads to Prehistoric Prism in Ironforge.

quests.name: Dragonmaw Rumors
quests.howTo: Breadcrumb from Hammerfall to the Deathstalker Agent in the Wetlands; required to unlock Open the Maw.

name: The Stockade
hordeAccess: Inside Stormwind City. A Horde character would have to fight through the capital's guards, so in practice Horde can't run it.

quests.name: The Stockade Riots
quests.prereq: Bazil Thredd (Unsent Letter chain from the Deadmines)
quests.howTo: Continue the Unsent Letter chain at the Stockade. Kill Bazil Thredd inside and bring back his head.

quests.name: What Comes Around...
quests.howTo: Pick up in Lakeshire. Kill Targorr the Dread and bring back his head.

quests.name: Crime and Punishment
quests.howTo: Pick up in Darkshire. Kill Dextren Ward and bring back his hand.

quests.name: Quell the Uprising
quests.howTo: Pick up at the Stockade door. Kill Defias prisoners, convicts and insurgents inside.

quests.name: The Color of Blood
quests.howTo: Pick up in Old Town. Collect Red Wool Bandanas from the prisoners inside.

quests.name: The Fury Runs Deep
quests.howTo: Pick up at Dun Modr. Kill Kam Deepfury inside the Stockade and bring back his head.

name: City of Dalaran
hordeAccess: Horde must finish the Tarren Mill chain (Prison Break-In, Key to the City, Dalaran Patrols, Blood in the Streets) from Magus Wordeen Voidglare to get the Dalaran Sewer Key; one key holder opens the sewer gate for the group. Sewer entrance is by Lordamere Lake (Warcraft Tavern gives 69.3, 45.6 on the Silverpine map); the key does not grant open-world access to the city. Horde are attacked on sight in the open city.

quests.name: Prison Break-In
quests.howTo: Collect the four Bloodstone pieces (Wedge, Marble, Shard, Oval) from the Darkmar family mobs at the Lordamere Internment Camp.

quests.name: Key to the City
quests.prereq: Offered alongside Prison Break-In (Warcraft Tavern says after it)
quests.howTo: Take the Grimy Key from the Warden's Footlocker in Kegan's house at the internment camp and return it with the Bloodstones to Wordeen.

quests.name: Dalaran Patrols
quests.location: Tarren Mill; objectives in the ruins outside Dalaran
quests.prereq: Prison Break-In and Key to the City
quests.howTo: Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 8 Elemental Slaves outside Dalaran.

quests.name: Blood in the Streets
quests.giver: Magus Wordeen Voidglare (ends at Image of Archmage Modera)
quests.location: Image of Archmage Modera at the Dalaran sewer entrance
quests.howTo: Speak to the Image of Archmage Modera at the sewer entrance; she gives the Dalaran Sewer Key. One key holder in the party opens the gate.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.howTo: Defeat the Shade of the Archmage and loot an Arcane Mote, then return to Wordeen in Tarren Mill; leads to Shrewd Negotiations.

quests.name: Source of Power
quests.howTo: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores from Fragmented Sentry golems in the Dalaran streets.

quests.name: The Grave Knight
quests.howTo: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight, the first boss, in the sewers.

quests.name: Opportunistic Education
quests.location: Inside the dungeon, just past the entrance
quests.howTo: Grab The Founding of Dalaran tome from the far end of the Atrium of Fortune and return it to Rexxie.

quests.name: An Alarming Request
quests.howTo: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera beside Lordamere Lake near Dalaran, who then offers the dungeon quests and sewer access.

quests.name: Starving Arcane
quests.howTo: Kill 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants and 8 Mana Echoes.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.howTo: Defeat the Shade of the Archmage, loot an Arcane Mote and return to Modera; leads to Friend of the Kirin Tor.

quests.name: Power Overwhelming
quests.howTo: Slay the Arcanic Enigma in northeast Dalaran.

quests.name: A Green Sample
quests.howTo: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from Runeweaver Square inside the dungeon.

name: Gnomeregan
hordeAccess: West of Ironforge in Alliance-held Dun Morogh, with no Horde flight point nearby. Groups ride in through the Wetlands and Loch Modan, avoiding the guards.

quests.name: Save Techbot's Brain!
quests.howTo: Pick up in Tinker Town (Brother Sarno in Stormwind can send you). Kill Techbot just inside Gnomeregan and bring back its memory core.

quests.name: Gnogaine
quests.howTo: Pick up in Kharanos. Use the empty vial on irradiated mobs inside to collect Gnogaine.

quests.name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
quests.howTo: Follow-up to Gnogaine. Collect High Potency Radioactive Fallout from irradiated mobs deeper inside.

quests.name: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators
quests.howTo: Pick up in Stormwind. Collect Robo-mechanical Guts from mechanical mobs inside.

quests.name: Chief Engineer Scooty
quests.howTo: Pick up from Sovik in Orgrimmar and travel to Chief Engineer Scooty in Booty Bay. Leads to Gnomer-gooooone!

quests.name: Gnomer-gooooone!
quests.howTo: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the transponder. The reward, a Goblin Transponder, lets Horde teleport from Booty Bay straight into Gnomeregan.

quests.name: A Fine Mess
quests.howTo: Find Kernobee inside and escort him to Clockwerk Run. Turn in to Scooty in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Essential Artificials
quests.howTo: Pick up in Tinker Town. Collect Essential Artificials from machines inside.

quests.name: Rig Wars
quests.howTo: Pick up from Nogg. Take the Rig Blueprints from the safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg, and kill Thermaplugg for his Safe Combination.

quests.name: Data Rescue
quests.howTo: Pick up in Tinker Town. Use the color-coded punch card terminals inside to make a Prismatic Punch Card.

quests.name: The Grand Betrayal
quests.howTo: Pick up from Mekkatorque. Kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg at the end of Gnomeregan.

quests.name: Workshop Key
quests.howTo: Every player can loot it from Electrocutioner 6000. It opens Gnomeregan's back (workshop) entrance; the key disappears if you log out.

name: Razorfen Kraul
hordeAccess: Southern Barrens near the Thousand Needles border. Fly to Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Blueleaf Tubers
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ratchet with the crate, snufflenose command stick and whistle. Have the snufflenose gopher dig up Blueleaf Tubers inside.

quests.name: Willix the Importer
quests.howTo: Free Willix inside the dungeon and escort him to the entrance.

quests.name: Mortality Wanes
quests.howTo: Pick up from Heralath Fallowbrook's corpse inside. Find Treshala's Pendant and bring it to Treshala Fallowbrook in Darnassus.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
quests.howTo: Loot the Small Scroll from Charlga Razorflank and take it to Varimathras in Undercity. Leads to a Razorfen Downs quest.

quests.name: A Vengeful Fate
quests.howTo: Pick up in Thunder Bluff. Kill Charlga Razorflank and bring back her heart.

quests.name: The Crone of the Kraul
quests.howTo: Pick up in Thalanaar. Kill Charlga Razorflank and bring back her medallion.

quests.name: Going, Going, Guano!
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Collect Kraul Guano from bats inside Razorfen Kraul.

name: Scarlet Monastery
hordeAccess: Northeast Tirisfal Glades, a short ride from the Undercity and Brill.

quests.name: Vorrel's Revenge
quests.howTo: Talk to the dying Vorrel Sengutz inside the Graveyard. Get his wedding ring back from Nancy Vishas in the Alterac Mountains, then return to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.prereq: Dorn Plainstalker's Test of Faith chain
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat book in the Library wing.

quests.name: Compendium of the Fallen
quests.howTo: Not available to Undead. Pick up in Thunder Bluff and find the Compendium of the Fallen in the Library wing.

quests.name: Mythology of the Titans
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ironforge. Find the Mythology of the Titans book in the Library wing.

quests.name: Hearts of Zeal
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Collect Hearts of Zeal from Scarlet mobs in any wing.

quests.name: Into The Scarlet Monastery
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Kill Bloodmage Thalnos, Houndmaster Loksey, Arcanist Doan and High Inquisitor Whitemane.

quests.name: In the Name of the Light
quests.howTo: Pick up in Southshore. Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod and Houndmaster Loksey.

quests.name: The Scarlet Key
quests.howTo: Loot it from the chest behind Arcanist Doan at the end of the Library. It opens the Armory and Cathedral wings.

name: The Drowned City
hordeAccess: Fly to Grom'gol Base Camp and swim west past the Vile Reef to the underwater cavern Sunken Hollow (~21.4, 27.8, marked by a large tablet). Water breathing helps.

quests.name: Shady Saltseers
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Voodoo-Infused Artifacts from the pirates inside.

quests.name: The Saltseer Captain
quests.howTo: Kill Captain Dreadrise and 3 Saltseer Coroners.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets
quests.howTo: Bring back an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Primeval Elemental.

quests.name: The Vile Reef
quests.howTo: Recover a Tablet Shard from the tablet at the bottom of the Vile Reef; starts the chain into the dungeon.

quests.name: Enemies in the Water
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers near the entrance.

quests.name: The Gurubashi Legends of Old
quests.howTo: Make a rubbing of the Fall of Gurubashi tablet underwater.

quests.name: Locating the Lost City
quests.howTo: Find the underwater cavern Sunken Hollow (~21, 28), the dungeon entrance.

quests.name: The Drowned City
quests.howTo: Make rubbings of the four Tablets of I'lalai inside the dungeon and return them to Kin'weelay.

quests.name: The Only Good Brinescale...
quests.howTo: Kill Var'Taka inside the dungeon.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
quests.howTo: Bring back the Ancient Gurubashi Idol dropped by the Primeval Elemental.

quests.name: Take Two With Water
quests.howTo: Get rubbings of the four I'lalai tablets inside.

quests.name: Magics of the Drowned City
quests.howTo: Collect 5 I'lalai Fetishes from the trolls inside.

name: Uldaman
hordeAccess: Northern Badlands. Fly to Kargath.

quests.name: Solution to Doom
quests.howTo: Pick up from Theldurin. Find the Tablet of Ryun'eh inside Uldaman and bring it to Theldurin.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Recover Garrett's family treasure from a chest in Uldaman.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ironforge. Recover Krom Stoutarm's treasure from a chest in Uldaman.

quests.name: Agmond's Fate
quests.howTo: Pick up in Loch Modan. Collect 4 Carved Stone Urns in the Uldaman caves just outside the instance portal.

quests.name: The Lost Dwarves
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ironforge. Find Baelog inside Uldaman.

quests.name: The Hidden Chamber
quests.howTo: Pick up from Baelog inside. Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.

quests.name: Amulet of Secrets
quests.howTo: Pick up from Hammertoe Grez. Kill Magregan Deepshadow in the outer dig site for Hammertoe's Amulet.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
quests.howTo: Pick up in Ironforge. Find the Tablet of Will inside Uldaman.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.howTo: Pick up in Kargath. Gather Magenta Fungus Caps inside Uldaman.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.howTo: Pick up in Orgrimmar. Start of the Horde necklace chain: find the necklace in Uldaman, then follow the paladin's remains and Jarkal Mossmeld steps.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.howTo: Recover the ruby (Shadowforge area), the topaz (urn in the troggs' area) and the sapphire (from Grimlok), plus a power source from Archaedas.

quests.name: The Shattered Necklace
quests.howTo: Loot the Shattered Necklace from Shadowforge dwarves and take it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge to start the Alliance necklace chain.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.howTo: Pick up in Thelsamar. Gather Magenta Fungus Caps inside Uldaman.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.howTo: Talk to the Discs of Norgannon after Archaedas. Bring the miniature discs to Sage Truthseeker (Thunder Bluff) or High Explorer Magellas (Ironforge).

quests.name: Staff of Prehistoria
quests.howTo: Combine The Shaft of Tsol (drops from Revelosh) with the Gni'kiv Medallion (from Baelog's Chest). Use the staff in the Map Room to open the Chamber of Khaz'mul to reach Ironaya.

name: Razorfen Downs
hordeAccess: Southern Barrens near the Thousand Needles border. Fly to Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: A Host of Evil
quests.location: The Barrens / outside the Razorfen Downs entrance
quests.howTo: Pick up just outside the instance. Kill Razorfen battleguards, thornweavers and quilguards.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
quests.howTo: Pick up from Varimathras. Kill Ambassador Malcin outside Razorfen Downs and bring back his head.

quests.name: Scourge of the Downs
quests.howTo: Talk to Belnistrasz, caged inside the dungeon, and hand back the Oathstone he gives you. Everyone in the group must finish it before the idol event.

quests.name: Extinguishing the Idol
quests.howTo: Escort Belnistrasz to the quilboar idol and protect him while he channels, then loot the brazier he leaves.

quests.name: Bring the End
quests.howTo: Pick up in Undercity. Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and bring back his skull.

quests.name: Bring the Light
quests.howTo: Pick up in the Cathedral. Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.

name: Krol'dok Stronghold
hordeAccess: Fly to Rog'mar in the middle of the Riverglades, ride north keeping left around the mountains; the portal is in a small cave west of the closed fortress gates (~37.5, 37.2). Contested zone; no attunement.

quests.name: Vengeance of the Highborne
quests.howTo: Kill Zalfan Moonshadow, a highborne cultist inside.

quests.name: A Token of Vengeance
quests.howTo: Collect 15 Cultist Ears from the cultists inside.

quests.name: Twilight Mementos
quests.howTo: Collect 8 Twilight Bangles inside.

quests.name: Tome of Twilight
quests.howTo: Take the Tome of Twilight from Nar'gurk.

quests.name: Tome of Twilight
quests.howTo: Take the Tome of Twilight from Nar'gurk.

quests.name: Eye of Mugg
quests.howTo: Kill Overlord Mugg and bring back the Eye of Mugg.

quests.name: Eye of Mugg
quests.howTo: Kill Overlord Mugg and bring back the Eye of Mugg.

quests.name: Krol'dok Moulding
quests.howTo: Starts the Krol'dok Compound Key chain (Key Ingredients: 4 Thick Leather + 12 Iron Bars). Not needed to enter; what the key opens is unconfirmed.

quests.name: Krol'dok Moulding
quests.howTo: Starts the Krol'dok Compound Key chain. Not needed to enter; what the key opens is unconfirmed.

name: Zul'Farrak
hordeAccess: Northwest Tanaris. Fly to Gadgetzan and ride west.

quests.name: Mallet of Zul'Farrak
quests.location: The Hinterlands / Altar of Zul and Jintha'Alor
quests.howTo: Get the Sacred Mallet from Qiaga the Keeper at the Altar of Zul, then use it at the altar on top of Jintha'Alor. One mallet in the group is needed to summon Gahz'rilla.

quests.name: The Spider God
quests.howTo: Kill Theka the Martyr inside, read the Tablet of Theka to learn the spider god's name, then report to Master Gadrin.

quests.name: Nekrum's Medallion
quests.howTo: Pick up at Nethergarde Keep. Kill Nekrum Gutchewer at the top of the temple steps and bring back his medallion.

quests.name: The Brassbolts Brothers
quests.howTo: Optional lead-in: go see Wizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway, who offers Gahz'rilla.

quests.name: Gahz'rilla
quests.howTo: Use the Mallet of Zul'Farrak at the gong pool to summon Gahz'rilla. Kill it and bring back Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale.

quests.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
quests.howTo: Pick up from Yeh'kinya. Kill Theka the Martyr and Hydromancer Velratha for the two Tablets of Mosh'aru.

quests.name: Scarab Shells
quests.howTo: Pick up in Gadgetzan. Collect Uncracked Scarab Shells from the scarabs that swarm out of the troll graves.

quests.name: Troll Temper
quests.howTo: Pick up in Gadgetzan. Collect Vials of Troll Temper from Sandfury trolls.

quests.name: Tiara of the Deep
quests.howTo: Pick up from Tabetha. Kill Hydromancer Velratha and bring back the Tiara of the Deep.

quests.name: Divino-matic Rod
quests.howTo: Pick up in Gadgetzan. Get the Divino-matic Rod from Sergeant Bly after the pyramid event.

name: Maraudon
hordeAccess: Western Desolace. Fly to Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from the Shadowshard creatures in Maraudon and bring them back to Uthel'nay.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments in Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh.

quests.name: Vyletongue Corruption
quests.howTo: Fill the vial at an orange crystal pool in Maraudon, use it on Vylestem Vines and heal 8 plants by killing the Noxxious Scions that appear.

quests.name: Vyletongue Corruption
quests.howTo: Fill the vial at an orange crystal pool in Maraudon, use it on Vylestem Vines and heal 8 plants.

quests.name: Twisted Evils
quests.howTo: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings from the creatures in Maraudon and return them to Willow.

quests.name: Legends of Maraudon
quests.howTo: Get the Celebrian Rod from Noxxion and the Celebrian Diamond from Lord Vyletongue, then kill Celebras the Cursed and speak to his ghost.

quests.name: The Scepter of Celebras
quests.location: Inside Maraudon, after Celebras the Cursed
quests.howTo: Stay with Celebras while he forges the Scepter of Celebras. The scepter opens the portal from the outer caves straight to Earth Song Falls.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
quests.location: Desolace, Sar'theris Strand near Shadowprey Village
quests.howTo: Kill Princess Theradras at the bottom of Maraudon and return to Selendra.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
quests.howTo: Kill Princess Theradras at the bottom of Maraudon and return to Keeper Marandis.

quests.name: The Pariah's Instructions
quests.location: Southern Desolace, east of Gelkis Village
quests.howTo: Defeat the five Khan spirits in Maraudon to free their gems, put them in the Amulet of Spirits and return it to the Pariah.

name: Alcaz Prison
hordeAccess: Fly to Brackenwall Village, ride to Dustwallow's north-east shore and swim to Alcaz Island; take the path up the hill from the dock to the tower basement portal (~75, 14). Talk to Sergeant Ulka (70.4, 19.0) before zoning in.

quests.name: The Dragon's Journal
quests.howTo: Bring back Zarla's Journal, dropped by Blazeroar.

quests.name: No Orc Left Behind
quests.location: Outside the prison, Alcaz Island, Dustwallow Marsh (70.4, 19.0)
quests.howTo: Find Ulka's commander, Commander Folkar, in the prison cells. Starts the Horde chain, which can only be picked up here.

quests.name: The Honor of the Kor'kron
quests.howTo: Search for King Varian Wrynn; the trail ends at a Perfumed Note after Blazeroar.

quests.name: Bad News for Folkar
quests.howTo: Return to Commander Folkar.

quests.name: Thrall Needs to Know
quests.location: Inside the prison; turn in at Orgrimmar
quests.howTo: Report Varian's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar (one source says Eitrigg in Grommash Hold).

quests.name: Blood Red Bandanas
quests.giver: Unconfirmed (probably a Kor'kron at the prison)
quests.location: Alcaz Island; turn in to Eitrigg, Grommash Hold, Orgrimmar
quests.howTo: Collect 8 Blood Red Bandanas from the Defias guards inside.

quests.name: A Little Payback
quests.howTo: Kill 15 Strashaz Soldiers and 8 Strashaz Enchantresses and bring back Ca'zass's Head.

name: Temple of Atal'Hakkar
hordeAccess: The sunken temple in the Swamp of Sorrows. Fly to Stonard.

quests.name: Jammal'an the Prophet
quests.howTo: Kill the six troll mini-bosses on the balcony to open the way, then kill Jammal'an and bring his head back to the Exile.

quests.name: Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Atal'ai Tablets from inside the Sunken Temple and return them to Brohann.

quests.name: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
quests.howTo: Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar from the trolls inside the Sunken Temple and bring them to Fel'Zerul.

quests.name: The God Hakkar
quests.howTo: Fill the Egg of Hakkar inside the Sunken Temple and bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar back to Yeh'kinya.

quests.name: Into the Depths
quests.howTo: Go to the bottom of the Sunken Temple and use the stone circle token at the Altar of Hakkar.

quests.name: Secret of the Circle
quests.howTo: Enter the Sunken Temple and uncover the secret hidden in the circle of statues for Marvon.

quests.name: Zapper Fuel
quests.howTo: Collect 5 Atal'ai Haze from murk worms, deep lurkers and oozes in the temple and take them with the Unloaded Zapper to Larion in Marshal's Refuge, Un'Goro.

quests.name: Haze of Evil
quests.howTo: Collect 5 Atal'ai Haze from murk worms, deep lurkers and oozes in the temple and bring them to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Essence of Eranikus
quests.giver: Essence of Eranikus (drops from Shade of Eranikus)
quests.howTo: Loot the Essence of Eranikus from the Shade of Eranikus and place it in the Essence Font in his lair.

name: Blackrock Depths
hordeAccess: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes. Fly to Kargath or Flame Crest.

quests.name: Attunement to the Core
quests.location: Blackrock Mountain, near the Molten Core portal
quests.howTo: Grab a Core Fragment from the Molten Core portal area inside BRD and bring it to Lothos to be attuned to Molten Core.

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
quests.location: Blackrock Mountain, on his tomb (visible only while dead)
quests.howTo: Talk to Franclorn as a ghost, then kill Fineous Darkvire for Ironfel and place it on the Shrine of Thaurissan to get the Shadowforge Key.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
quests.howTo: Kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen in BRD, then report to Warlord Goretooth.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.howTo: Kill Overmaster Pyron in the quarry just outside the BRD entrance and return to Thunderheart.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
quests.howTo: Find Commander Gor'shak in the BRD prison. This starts the chain that ends with The Royal Rescue.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
quests.howTo: Kill Lord Incendius in BRD and bring back the Tablet of Kurniya he drops.

quests.name: Overmaster Pyron
quests.howTo: Kill Overmaster Pyron in the quarry outside BRD and return to Jalinda Sprig.

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
quests.howTo: Find Marshal Windsor in the BRD prison. Part of the Alliance Onyxia attunement chain.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.howTo: Kill Emperor Dagran Thaurissan without killing Princess Moira, then go back to Thrall.

quests.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
quests.howTo: Get the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe from Hurley Blackbreath in the Grim Guzzler and return it to Vivian Lagrave.

quests.name: The Love Potion
quests.howTo: Bring Nagmara 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial (filled inside BRD).

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
quests.howTo: Get the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe from Hurley Blackbreath in the Grim Guzzler and return it to Ragnar.

quests.name: Jail Break!
quests.howTo: Escort Marshal Windsor as he grabs his gear and frees his friends, then report to Marshal Maxwell. Part of the Alliance Onyxia attunement.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
quests.howTo: Kill Emperor Dagran Thaurissan in BRD and save Princess Moira, then return to Magni.

quests.name: Prison Cell Key
quests.howTo: Kill High Interrogator Gerstahn in the Detention Block. Only one key drops and it opens the cells holding Kharan Mighthammer, Marshal Windsor and Commander Gor'shak.

name: Blackmaw Hold
hordeAccess: Travel to Azshara; a furbolg tunnel opens at ~38.7, 33.4 behind the long-sealed furbolg gate and leads to the portal (which sits on the Winterspring map at ~66.6, 84.4). No attunement.

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
hordeAccess: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes. Fly to Kargath or Flame Crest.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
quests.howTo: Fetch the third and fourth Mosh'aru Tablets from Zul'Mashar in Eastern Plaguelands; leads into The Final Tablets.

quests.name: The Final Tablets
quests.howTo: Collect the fifth and sixth Mosh'aru Tablets from the Smolderthorn trolls in LBRS and return to Ironboot.

quests.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
quests.howTo: Use the cage to capture a Bloodaxe Worg Pup in LBRS and bring it to Kibler.

quests.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
quests.howTo: Collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs in LBRS and bring them to Kibler.

quests.name: Urok Doomhowl
quests.howTo: Read Warosh's Scroll, summon and defeat Urok Doomhowl, and bring Warosh's Mojo back to Warosh.

quests.name: Operative Bijou
quests.howTo: Find out what happened to Bijou in Blackrock Spire; the chain continues with Bijou's Belongings.

quests.name: The Pack Mistress
quests.howTo: Kill Halycon, the Bloodaxe worg mistress in LBRS, and return to Galamav.

quests.name: Put Her Down
quests.howTo: Kill Halycon, the worg den mistress in LBRS, and return to Helendis.

quests.name: Warlord's Command
quests.howTo: Kill Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone and Overlord Wyrmthalak and loot the Important Blackrock Documents. First step of the Horde Onyxia attunement.

quests.name: Maxwell's Mission
quests.howTo: Kill War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk and Overlord Wyrmthalak in LBRS and report back.

name: Shaper's Terrace
hordeAccess: Fly to Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro Crater (neutral, both factions); the entrance is on the hill directly above it (~48.1, 6.1). Bring Power Crystals gathered around Un'Goro for the consoles inside.

quests.name: Crystals of Power
quests.howTo: Un'Goro pylon chain that has you gather Power Crystals; Blizzard says crystals gathered around Un'Goro power consoles inside the dungeon, but no source ties this chain to the dungeon.

name: Dire Maul
hordeAccess: Central Feralas. Fly to Camp Mojache, which is right next to it.

quests.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
quests.howTo: Chase the imp Pusillin through Warpwood Quarter (DM East) and kill him for Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations. He also drops the Crescent Key.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
quests.howTo: Kill Lethtendris in Dire Maul East and bring her web to Talo Thornhoof.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
quests.howTo: Kill Lethtendris in Dire Maul East and bring her web to Latronicus Moonspear.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.howTo: Search Dire Maul for the lost elven scholar the sage is looking for, then report back to Sage Korolusk.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.howTo: Search Dire Maul for the lost elven scholar the scholar is looking for, then report back to Scholar Runethorn.

quests.name: Shards of the Felvine
quests.howTo: Kill Alzzin the Wildshaper in DM East, then capture a Felvine Shard in the Reliquary of Purity and bring it to Rabine.

quests.name: The Madness Within
quests.howTo: Destroy the five pylon guardians in DM West, kill Immol'thar and then Prince Tortheldrin. Leads to The Treasure of the Shen'dralar.

quests.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
quests.location: Dire Maul North (after a tribute run)
quests.howTo: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might in DM North and bring it to Captain Kromcrush.

quests.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
quests.location: Dire Maul North, chained in the Gordok wing
quests.howTo: Bring Knot 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Thread and an Ogre Tannin to get a Gordok Ogre Suit.

quests.name: Crescent Key
quests.howTo: Talk to Pusillin just inside DM East, chase him through the wing and kill him when cornered. The key opens the doors into Dire Maul North and West.

name: Scholomance
hordeAccess: Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands. Ride from the Bulwark. You need the Skeleton Key to open the door.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.howTo: Collect the four deeds (Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, Southshore) inside Scholomance and return to Alexi. Leads to The Last Barov.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.howTo: Collect the four deeds inside Scholomance and return to Weldon. Leads to The Last Barov.

quests.name: Scholomance
quests.howTo: Speak with Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark to start the Skeleton Key chain.

quests.name: Scholomance
quests.howTo: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Camp to start the Skeleton Key chain.

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments
quests.howTo: Collect 15 Skeletal Fragments from the skeletons in Western Plaguelands (Felstone Field is a good spot).

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments
quests.howTo: Collect 15 Skeletal Fragments from the skeletons in Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mold Rhymes With...
quests.location: Western Plaguelands, The Bulwark / Chillwind Camp
quests.howTo: Take the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.howTo: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the lava lake on Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro, forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key and return to your Plaguelands quest giver.

quests.name: The Key to Scholomance
quests.howTo: Get Araj's Scarab from Araj the Summoner in Andorhal (Araj's Scarab), then turn in to receive the Skeleton Key.

quests.name: The Key to Scholomance
quests.howTo: Get Araj's Scarab from Araj the Summoner in Andorhal, then turn in to receive the Skeleton Key.

quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings
quests.howTo: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings in the Scholomance dragon room and return to Betina.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
quests.howTo: Kill Doctor Theolen Krastinov and burn the remains of Eva and Lucien Sarkhoff. Leads to Krastinov's Bag of Horrors.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.howTo: Place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier on the Scholomance porch and kill Kirtonos when he arrives.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.howTo: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room, kill Vectus and return to Betina.

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.howTo: Use the Soulbound Keepsake on Ras Frostwhisper, kill him and bring his head to Marduke.

name: Stratholme
hordeAccess: Northern Eastern Plaguelands. Fly to Light's Hope Chapel (neutral).

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.prereq: The Restless Souls (Caretaker Alen, Light's Hope Chapel)
quests.howTo: Free 15 Restless Souls (ghostly citizens) in Stratholme and return to Egan.

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
quests.howTo: Open supply crates in Stratholme and collect 5 Stratholme Holy Water.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
quests.howTo: Collect 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from the undead in Stratholme. Leads to The Active Agent.

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.howTo: Kill Archivist Galford on the Scarlet side and burn the Scarlet Archive. Leads to The Truth Comes Crashing Down.

quests.name: The Great Fras Siabi
quests.howTo: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco for Smokey LaRue.

quests.name: The Medallion of Faith
quests.howTo: Get the Medallion of Faith from Malor the Zealous in the Scarlet Bastion. Leads to Aurius' Reckoning.

quests.name: Ramstein
quests.prereq: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee... and The Corpulent One
quests.howTo: Kill Ramstein the Gorger on the undead side and bring his head to Nathanos.

quests.name: Dead Man's Plea
quests.location: Eastern Plaguelands, outside the Stratholme gates
quests.howTo: Kill Baron Rivendare within 45 minutes of opening the Gauntlet to save Ysida Harmon.

quests.name: Key to the City
quests.howTo: Kill Magistrate Barthilas in Elder's Square. The key opens the Eastwall Gate, the King's Square gate and the Gauntlet gate on the way to Baron Rivendare.

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
hordeAccess: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes. Fly to Kargath or Flame Crest. Needs the Seal of Ascension.

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
quests.howTo: Kill General Drakkisath, loot the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion and bring it to Haleh for the Drakefire Amulet.

quests.name: For The Horde!
quests.howTo: Kill Warchief Rend Blackhand in UBRS and bring his head to Thrall. Part of the Horde Onyxia attunement.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
quests.howTo: Kill General Drakkisath in UBRS and return to Marshal Maxwell.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
quests.howTo: Kill General Drakkisath, loot his blood and bring it to Rokaro for the Drakefire Amulet (Onyxia key).

quests.name: Seal of Ascension
quests.location: Lower Blackrock Spire, Hordemar City ledge
quests.howTo: Collect the gemstones of Spirestone (Highlord Omokk), Smolderthorn (War Master Voone) and Bloodaxe (Overlord Wyrmthalak) plus the Unadorned Seal in LBRS, then return to Vaelan.

quests.name: The Darkstone Tablet
quests.prereq: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
quests.howTo: Get the Darkstone Tablet from the hatchery area past Pyroguard Emberseer and bring it to Vivian Lagrave.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.howTo: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the UBRS Rookery. Leads to Egg Collection.

quests.name: The Matron Protectorate
quests.howTo: Take Awbee's Scale to Haleh in Winterspring; starts the Wrath of the Blue Flight chain.

quests.name: Seal of Ascension (forging)
quests.location: Lower Blackrock Spire, Hordemar City ledge
quests.howTo: Defeat Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog (Dustwallow Marsh), use the Orb of Draconic Energy on him and have him forge the seal. The finished Seal of Ascension opens the UBRS door.

name: Barrow Deeps
notes: Tunnels from Blackmaw Hold lead toward the raid. One wiki line says 20 players; every other source says 10.
hordeAccess: Level 60, 10-player raid within Mount Hyjal; Blizzard says entrances also link to Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold. Opens 9 December 2026; no attunement announced.

name: Hyjal Summit
hordeAccess: Level 60, 20-player raid at the summit of Mount Hyjal near Nordrassil. Opens 9 December 2026; no attunement announced.

name: Onyxia's Lair
hordeAccess: The Wyrmbog in southern Dustwallow Marsh. Fly to Brackenwall Village. You need the Drakefire Amulet.

quests.name: Dragonkin Menace
quests.howTo: Kill black dragonkin in Burning Steppes. First step of the Alliance Onyxia attunement (continues with The True Masters and Marshal Windsor in BRD).

quests.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
quests.howTo: Meet Squire Rowe at the Stormwind gates so he can call Marshal Windsor.

quests.name: The Great Masquerade
quests.howTo: Escort Reginald Windsor through Stormwind as he unmasks Lady Prestor (raid group needed).

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
quests.howTo: Bring Haleh the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath in UBRS to get the Drakefire Amulet, the key to Onyxia's Lair.

quests.name: Warlord's Command
quests.howTo: Kill the three LBRS generals and bring back the Important Blackrock Documents. First step of the Horde Onyxia attunement.

quests.name: The Champion of the Horde
quests.howTo: Find Rexxar, who patrols the road through Desolace between Stonetalon and Feralas.

quests.name: Mistress of Deception
quests.howTo: Take Rokaro's Letter to Myranda the Hag at Sorrow Hill in Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Emberstrife
quests.howTo: Wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion inside Emberstrife's Den in the Wyrmbog (Dustwallow Marsh) and speak with Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls
quests.howTo: Kill the drake champions Scryer, Somnus, Chronalis and Axtroz (Grim Batol) and bring their skulls to Emberstrife.

quests.name: Ascension...
quests.howTo: Show the Dull Drakefire Amulet to Rokaro in Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
quests.howTo: Kill General Drakkisath in UBRS and bring his blood to Rokaro to get the Drakefire Amulet, the key to Onyxia's Lair.

quests.name: Victory for the Horde
quests.howTo: Loot the Head of Onyxia and bring it to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Victory for the Alliance
quests.howTo: Loot the Head of Onyxia and bring it to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.
